230.5.10.1(1).explanation: For a building constructed under a permit issued more than three years after May 9, 2013, the number of bicycle parking spaces comes from a table that sets short-term and long-term rates by use. Most rates differ between Bicycle Zone 1 and Bicycle Zone 2, which are map areas, so they are shown but not calculated here. Crisis care facilities and municipal shelters need at least 2 long-term spaces.

230.5.10.1(3).explanation: If the uses on a lot, other than dwelling units, add up to 2000 square metres of interior floor area or less, no bicycle parking space is required for them, despite the table rates and the dwelling-unit rates.

230.5.10.1(4).explanation: When the table requires bicycle parking for more than one use on a lot, the total required is the sum of the spaces required for each use.

230.5.10.1(5).explanation: Apartment and mixed use buildings need at least 1.1 bicycle parking spaces per dwelling unit in Bicycle Zone 1 (0.9 long-term, 0.2 short-term) and at least 0.75 per dwelling unit in Bicycle Zone 2 (0.68 long-term, 0.07 short-term). The zone is a map area that is not held, so the rate is not calculated here.
